children: Juhas Peter, AerCap's Chief Financial Officer and an officer of the company, sold 20,000 ordinary shares on November 10, 2026, in multiple transactions at weighted average prices of $174.71 and $175.59 per share. The sales totaled approximately $3,502,108. Following the transactions, he directly owned 163,574 ordinary shares and indirectly owned 194,079 ordinary shares through the AerCap Holdings N.V. Equity Incentive Plans Trust.
